title: Solar, battery and hybrid siting
why: Ranks land across Great Britain for solar, standalone battery storage and solar with battery on a shared connection.

title: Onshore wind siting
why: Adds onshore wind to the same ranked map, with noise buffers, peat and designations, and links out for radar and military safeguarding.

title: Evidence for every number
why: Each figure shows its source, version, date and licence.

title: Pushback with what changed
why: Change an assumption and a card lists the sites that moved and the reason.

title: Site upload and screening
why: Upload a boundary, KML or shapefile and screen it against the same rules as the map.

title: Pipeline board
why: Tracks each site on the connection evidence ladder, with Gate 2 and land-rights clocks.

title: Documents
why: Feasibility report, grid pack, investment committee pack and Excel model for any site.

title: GB rules cards
why: Dated cards on consent routes, Gate 2 milestones and battery fire-safety guidance, each with a review date.

title: Company holdings
why: Group, substation and league views, Gate 2 positions with no planning application, and idle connections.

title: Change feed and weekly digest
why: New connection applications, Gate changes and holder changes, in the app and by email, filtered by watchlists.

title: Diligence
why: Checks a seller's site list against the public record and exports a data-room PDF and workbook.

title: "Can I build here?" journeys
why: Three guided checks for a landowner, a developer and an investor, each ending in a one-page summary.

title: Weekly data refresh
why: The registers and published datasets are rebuilt every week, and the snapshots keep their history.

title: Data API and MCP server
why: Read-only access for your own tools and AI assistants, with per-organisation keys.

title: Screening call
why: Send a boundary or a list of sites and get the verdict and reasons back as data. Available to API customers on request.

title: Report call
why: Request a landowner check, feasibility report or portfolio screen and receive the PDF and its data when it is ready. Available to API customers on request.

title: Change webhooks
why: Signed pushes for new connection applications, Gate changes, holder changes and planning moves on a watchlist. Available to API customers on request.

title: Per-site yield with P50 and P90
why: Yield feeds the price needed to hit the hurdle, and lenders and committees ask for P90.

title: CfD AR8 and AR9 eligibility screen
why: Flags whether a site's consent status and Gate 2 position fit the next allocation rounds.

title: Aerial imagery checks
why: Shows current aerial imagery beside each site, to catch quarries, new housing and other land use the datasets lag behind.

title: Network-operator budget estimates and cable routing
why: Route-based cable costs and budget estimates from charging statements, because connection cost is the largest uncertainty in the early numbers.

title: Online checkout
why: Pay for a one-off report online. Until then, orders come by email and we invoice.

title: Council political context
why: Council control and policy stance beside the planning record, where the data licence allows it.

title: Northern Ireland
why: Coverage of Northern Ireland using its own planning, grid and land datasets.
